import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static List<long[]> chooset;
    static int R, C;

    static long choose(int n, int r) {
        if (n >= 0 && n < chooset.size() && r >= 0 && r < chooset.get(n).length) {
            return chooset.get(n)[r];
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static long bit(int x) {
        return 1L << x;
    }

    static List<Long> recurse(int L, int N, int a, int na, long req, long excl, long cur, List<Long> sums) {
        if (na > N - L)
            return sums;
        if (L == N) {
            sums.add(cur);
            return sums;
        }
        long mask = bit(L);
        if ((req & mask) == 0)
            recurse(L + 1, N, a, na, req, excl, cur, sums);
        if (na > 0 && (excl & mask) == 0) {
            long nxt = cur + choose(a, R - 1) * choose(L - a, R);
            recurse(L + 1, N, a + 1, na - 1, req, excl, nxt, sums);
        }
        return sums;
    }

    static long[] solve(String pattern) {
        int N = pattern.length();
        long base = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < R + C; i++)
            base += choose(i, R - 1) * choose(N - i - 1, R);
        long unfair = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        long trg = 2 * base - choose(N, 2 * R);

        long req = 0, excl = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (pattern.charAt(i) == 'A')
                req |= bit(i);
            else if (pattern.charAt(i) == 'B')
                excl |= bit(i);
        }

        long[][] dp = new long[R + C + 1][R + C + 1];
        for (long[] row : dp) Arrays.fill(row, 0);
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j <= R + C; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= R + C; k++) {
                if (j >= R - 1 && k >= R)
                    break;
                if (j < R + C && pattern.charAt(j + k) != 'B')
                    dp[j + 1][k] += dp[j][k];
                if (k < R + C && pattern.charAt(j + k) != 'A')
                    dp[j][k + 1] += dp[j][k];
            }
        }

        int M = N - C;
        List<Long>[] asums2 = new ArrayList[R + C + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= R + C; i++) {
            asums2[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int al = R - 1; al <= R + C; al++) {
            recurse(M, N, al, R + C - al, req, excl, 0L, asums2[al]);
            Collections.sort(asums2[al], Collections.reverseOrder());
        }

        long unfairMin = unfair;
        long totalAns = 0;

        for (int a = R - 1; a <= R + C; a++) {
            for (int b = R; b <= R + C; b++) {
                if (a > R - 1 && b > R) continue;
                if (dp[a][b] == 0) continue;
                int L = a + b;
                for (int l = 0; l <= M - L; l++) {
                    int r = R + C - a - l;
                    if (r > N - M || r < 0) continue;

                    List<Long> sums1 = new ArrayList<>();
                    recurse(L, M, a, l, req, excl, 0L, sums1);
                    List<Long> sums2 = asums2[a + l];

                    Collections.sort(sums1);
                    int p = 0, q = 0;
                    int p2 = 0, q2 = 0;
                    int sizeSums1 = sums1.size();
                    int sizeSums2 = sums2.size();

                    while (p < sizeSums1 && q < sizeSums2) {
                        while (p2 < sizeSums1 && sums1.get(p2).equals(sums1.get(p))) p2++;
                        while (q2 < sizeSums2 && sums2.get(q2).equals(sums2.get(q))) q2++;
                        long total = 2 * (sums1.get(p) + sums2.get(q));
                        long diff = Math.abs(total - trg);
                        if (diff < unfairMin) {
                            unfairMin = diff;
                            totalAns = 0;
                        }
                        if (diff == unfairMin) {
                            totalAns += (long)(p2 - p) * (q2 - q) * dp[a][b];
                        }
                        if (total > trg) {
                            q = q2;
                        } else {
                            p = p2;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return new long[]{unfairMin, totalAns};
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        R = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        String pattern = br.readLine();

        int N = 2 * (R + C);
        chooset = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            long[] row = new long[i + 1];
            row[0] = 1;
            row[i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                row[j] = chooset.get(i - 1)[j - 1] + chooset.get(i - 1)[j];
            }
            chooset.add(row);
        }

        long[] opt = solve(new String(new char[N]).replace('\0', '?'));
        long[] score = solve(pattern);
        if (score[0] == opt[0])
            System.out.println(score[1]);
        else
            System.out.println(0);
    }
}
